items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX Stock Just Closed Above Its $135 IPO Price for the First Time in Weeks. Is the Rebound a Buy Signal?
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 股价重新站上 $135 IPO 价格，报道讨论是否构成买入信号，直接利好 SPCX/SPCH/RKLX 持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's X is exploring stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers
items.summary_cn: Musk 的 X 平台正探索用稳定币向内容创作者支付，利好稳定币生态，间接利好 CRCL(USDC 发行方)。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s Starbase wants to expand in south Texas
items.summary_cn: SpaceX Starbase 申请扩建南德州基地，长期利好 SpaceX 发射与产能扩张，间接支撑 SPCX/SPCH 持仓估值。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX recovers Starship spacecraft Elon Musk once feared lost to sea
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 成功回收曾被认为将坠海的 Starship 飞船，技术可靠性提升，利好 SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Trump
items.text: No one has given the Islamic Republic of Iran a greater opportunity to make a Deal than me. TRAGICALLY, for them, they have failed to take it. Therefore, today, I am announcing the MOST CRUSHING ECONOMIC OPERATION EVER TAKEN AGAINST ANY COUNTRY! This will be Economic Warfare and Isolation on an unprecedented scale. Their navy is gone, their air force is destroyed, their military factories are now rubble, their currency is worthless, and their country is hanging by a thread. Today, I am also announcing that ANY country that allows its financial institutions, businesses, airports, or government
items.summary_cn: Trump 宣布对伊朗发动史上最大规模经济战与制裁，警告第三国不得与伊朗金融/航空往来，将冲击原油与航运板块，金风科技(风电)受益于能源替代叙事。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX will try for 1st Starship tower catch 'in a few months,' Elon Musk says
items.summary_cn: Musk 称 SpaceX 数月内将首次尝试 Starship 塔架捕获，技术里程碑利好 SpaceX 估值。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Nvidia’s Stake in SpaceX—and Musk’s Massive Holdings
items.summary_cn: 报道 Nvidia 持有 SpaceX 股权，并梳理 Musk 庞大持仓版图，凸显 AI/半导体-航天产业链联动，间接利好海力士(AI 存储)。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I have paused the 50% Tariffs against Canada, that were scheduled to kick in tomorrow morning for a three day period, based on the fact that Canada and the U.S.A., subject to the finalization of documents, have a DEAL! The great Keystone XL Pipeline, long ago killed by Sleepy Joe Biden, may be awoken from the grave! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 暂缓对加拿大 50% 关税 3 天，因美加达成框架协议并可能重启 Keystone XL 输油管线，关税风险短期降温利好风险偏好。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla’s true believers are starting to question their faith in Elon Musk
items.summary_cn: 报道称 Tesla 铁粉开始质疑 Musk，Tesla 基本面与品牌叙事承压。
